Welcome to Pho House, one of the best Vietnamese Cuisine in Mount Hope, WV 25880. At Pho House, we honor Vietnamese culinary traditions while delivering a modern dining experience. Our dishes are prepared using time-tested cooking methods, fresh ingredients, and a dedication to authentic flavors. Combined with a welcoming ambiance and attentive service, we strive to create a restaurant experience that stands out for both quality and comfort.

Our pho is the heart of our menu. Each bowl features carefully simmered broth, tender rice noodles, fresh herbs, and flavorful proteins. It’s a nourishing and satisfying meal perfect for any time of day.
Enjoy a variety of rice plates and vermicelli bowls topped with grilled meats, crisp vegetables, and house-made sauces. These balanced dishes offer a delicious combination of textures and flavors.
Complement your meal with a selection of refreshing drinks including Vietnamese iced coffee, teas, smoothies, and specialty beverages. Each drink is crafted to enhance your dining enjoyment.
